title: Deciphering molecular composition and summarizing control strategies of unknown disinfection byproducts in water and wastewater based on FT-ICR-MS analysis: A comprehensive review
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D4EW00889H, Critical Review
Changmin Wang, Bingliang Zhang, Youzhuang Rong, Xifeng Shi, Yunyan Liu
Disinfection is crucial to inactivate pathogenic bacteria and prevent the spread of epidemic diseases during drinking water/wastewater treatment. However, adverse disinfection by-products (DBPs) are inevitably produced during the disinfection process....
